categories.main_business_segments: Sieyuan Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the power transmission and distribution equipment industry, focusing on R&D, design, manufacturing, sales, and services of electrical equipment. Key product lines include GIS and GIL up to 750kV, high-voltage circuit breakers, isolating switches, power capacitors, transformers, reactors, current and voltage transformers, and energy storage systems. The company also engages in EPC (engineering, procurement, and construction) projects and automotive electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in power system primary equipment (mechanical), secondary equipment (control), energy storage, and power quality management. It emphasizes innovation in flexible DC transmission, renewable energy integration, energy storage, environmental protection, IoT, and automotive electronics. Production is mainly made-to-order (MTO) or engineer-to-order (ETO), reflecting high customization. EPC projects cover design, procurement, construction, and commissioning with longer delivery cycles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sieyuan serves primarily electric power grid companies, including State Grid and Southern Power Grid, as well as industries like power generation (especially renewable energy), rail transit, petrochemical, and metallurgy. Its products are widely used in domestic power infrastructure and increasingly in overseas markets such as the UK, Italy, Saudi Arabia, and Kuwait. The company also targets automotive manufacturers for its supercapacitor products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with strong sales in East China, North China, South China, Northeast, Central, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It has a growing international presence with subsidiaries and projects in over 100 countries, including Kenya, Hong Kong, UAE, Mexico, Switzerland, Russia, Brazil, Egypt, Zambia, Ivory Coast, Philippines, Sierra Leone, Botswana, Nigeria, Spain, Uzbekistan, India, and the USA.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sieyuan operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying power transmission and distribution equipment and providing EPC turnkey project services. It also engages in upstream R&D and innovation for core components and energy storage technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation aligned with new power system development, focusing on smart grid solutions, flexible DC transmission, energy storage, supercapacitors, and automotive electronics. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 4,400 R&D personnel and 897 patents, including 327 invention patents. Strategic R&D projects include dry-type bushings, environmentally friendly circuit breakers, static synchronous compensators (SSC), and frequency regulation energy storage systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized power transmission and distribution equipment and EPC project contracts. The company also earns income from equipment leasing and investment returns. Sales are predominantly direct, with a significant portion from domestic markets and a growing share from international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sieyuan is positioned as a leading domestic player in the power transmission and distribution equipment industry with comprehensive capabilities in primary and secondary equipment, energy storage, and EPC services. It competes with other major Chinese and international electrical equipment manufacturers, leveraging its strong R&D, product quality, and expanding global footprint to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sieyuan reported revenue of approximately RMB 15.46 billion, a 24.06% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.05 billion, up 31.42%. Total assets reached RMB 23.47 billion, growing 25.3% from the previous year. The company has demonstrated consistent growth in orders, revenue, and profitability, supported by increased R&D investment and expanding market share domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sieyuan emphasizes innovation-driven development, offering integrated solutions across traditional mechanical equipment, control systems, energy storage, and power quality management. Its products are highly customized, technologically advanced, and supported by strong after-sales service networks globally. The company’s commitment to quality, innovation, and customer-centric service differentiates it in the competitive power equipment market, particularly in emerging areas like supercapacitors and smart grid technologies.
